D CORE LC/UPC Female to SC/UPC Male Hybrid Fiber Adapter

The D CORE LC/UPC Female to SC/UPC Male Simplex Single Mode Hybrid Fiber Optical Adapter is a high-quality fiber optic adapter designed for seamless LC to SC fiber connections. This compact and efficient adapter allows users to connect and convert fiber optic cables between LC and SC connectors, ensuring smooth and stable data transmission in various indoor and outdoor environments. Built for single mode fiber networks, this hybrid adapter ensures low insertion loss and high precision alignment, maintaining superior optical performance. Whether used in telecommunication systems, data centers, or fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) applications, it provides a reliable and cost-effective solution for fiber optic connectivity. The D CORE LC to SC adapter features a male-to-female connector type, making it easy to integrate with existing fiber optic setups. Its durable plastic housing ensures long-lasting performance, while the compact and lightweight design (weighing only 10 grams) allows for easy installation and portability. With a dimension of 7.7 x 4.4 x 0.9 cm, it is a space-saving solution that fits well in various networking environments. Designed for both indoor and outdoor usage, this adapter is suitable for fiber optic splicing, testing equipment, and network installations. The blue and white color coding helps in easy identification and quick deployment. Additionally, the hybrid adapter's special design ensures efficient signal conversion between different connector types, eliminating the need for complex cabling changes. Packaged in a secure shipping box, the D CORE LC/UPC Female to SC/UPC Male Hybrid Adapter is a reliable, high-performance, and easy-to-use solution for professionals looking to connect single mode fiber devices with SC or LC ports. Whether for commercial, industrial, or home fiber optic applications, this hybrid adapter guarantees efficient and seamless fiber connectivity.

Features of D CORE LC/UPC Female to SC/UPC Male Hybrid Fiber Adapter

  • Hybrid Adapter (SC-LC) – Converts LC/UPC Female to SC/UPC Male for seamless fiber optic connectivity.
  • Single Mode Compatibility – Designed for single mode fiber devices, ensuring low insertion loss and high precision signal transmission.
  • Male-to-Female Connector – Easy integration with LC and SC fiber optic ports without requiring additional adapters.
  • Indoor & Outdoor Use – Suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments, making it ideal for FTTH, data centers, and telecom networks.
  • Compact & Lightweight – Small form factor with dimensions of 7.7 x 4.4 x 0.9 cm and a weight of 10 grams, ensuring easy installation.
  • Durable Build Quality – Sturdy plastic housing with a secure fit, providing long-lasting performance.
  • Easy Identification – Blue and white color-coded design allows for quick recognition and deployment in fiber networks.
  • Versatile Application – Ideal for fiber splicing, testing equipment, and network expansion, offering a cost-effective solution for fiber optic connections.
